text:
[Photograph: Group portrait of College Faculty of Savoy Male and Female College, 1883-1884. Four men posed together, two standing and two seated. Caption reads:

COLLEGE FACULTY OF SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
1883-1884

Lee W. Pierce, A.B.          J. T. Ashcraft, B.S.
Lewis Holland, Vice-President          R. B. Halsell, President]
notes: Page header reads '164 THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE'. Full-page group photograph of four faculty members from 1883-1884.
